title: Skypart : Weather-Robust Cross-View Geo-Localization via Prototype-Based Semantic Part Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2605.11654v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The low-altitude economy is growing rapidly, increasing demand for reliable drone navigation. Common tasks such as delivery, inspection, and search-and-rescue rely on Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS), which can be jammed, spoofed, or unavailable. Cross-view geo-localization (CVGL), which matches an oblique drone view to a geo-referenced satellite tile, offers an alternative for autonomous localization when GNSS fails. However, current CVGL methods have three limitations: (1) global descriptors compress patch grids into a single vector, without separating cross-view-shared layout from view-specific texture; (2) altitude-related scale variation remains in the learned embedding instead of being marginalized as a nuisance; and (3) multi-objective training uses hand-tuned loss weights despite incompatible gradient scales. translated_title: Skypart：基于原型语义部件发现的天气鲁棒跨视角地理定位
translated_abstract: 低空经济正在迅速增长，对可靠无人机导航的需求不断增加。诸如配送、巡检和搜救等常见任务依赖于全球导航卫星系统（GNSS），而GNSS可能被干扰、欺骗或不可用。跨视角地理定位（CVGL）通过将倾斜的无人机视角图像与地理参考卫星影像块进行匹配，为GNSS失效时的自主定位提供了一种替代方案。然而，当前的CVGL方法存在三个局限：（1）全局描述符将图像块网格压缩为单一向量，未能将跨视角共享的布局结构与视角特定的纹理分离开来；（2）与高度相关的尺度变化仍保留在学习到的嵌入中，而未作为干扰因素被边缘化；（3）多目标训练在梯度尺度不兼容的情况下仍使用手工调整的损失权重。我们提出SKYPART，一种面向基于图像块的视觉Transformer（ViT）的轻量级、可替换的头部模块，它利用……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出SKYPART——一种基于原型语义部件发现的轻量级可替换ViT头部模块，通过分离跨视角共享布局、边缘化高度相关尺度变化并优化多目标训练，实现了天气鲁棒的跨视角地理定位，为GNSS失效时的无人机自主定位提供了新方案。
en_tdlr: SKYPART is a lightweight, swappable head for patch-based ViTs that achieves weather-robust cross-view geo-localization through prototype-based semantic part discovery, addressing limitations in global descriptors, altitude-related scale variation, and hand-tuned multi-objective training for GNSS-denied drone navigation.
